messages.subject: call grad() twice
parts:
Is it possible to call grad() and then build the auto-diff tree
differently and call grad again like in the example below?

{
var a = 1;
AVEC x;
x.push_back(a);

var a2 = a*20;
VEC g1;
a2.grad(x, g1);
EXPECT_FLOAT_EQ(g1[0], 20); //works fine

var a3 = a*35;
VEC g2;
a3.grad(x, g2);
EXPECT_FLOAT_EQ(g2[0], 35); //fails: Value of: 35 Expected: g2[0]
Which is: 75
}

(I actually don't understand what grad() does internally, and so far,
I've only needed to call it once to get the derivatives). Also, is there
documentation for this anywhere?
